Description.SourceString:
The ancient Potteringtons, a lineage of strange old women that dates back as far as recorded history, consider farming to be a sacred art. It is said that under a full moon they consume a tea brewed from the first leaves to grow on Gielinor, and in doing so are imparted inscrutable farming wisdom.

Nonsense, perhaps, yet this ring contains a single bead of that mystical tea and those who wear it find themselves agriculturally inspired.
